_about: Product 'Clinical Research' block for every product carrying Matrixyl 3000, 2026-09-22. Replaces the old block that was live on six products with three claims that failed at source (docs/claims/matrixyl-3000.md §2): '+117% collagen I / +327% collagen IV' (untraceable; Sederma's own patent measured collagen IV +20%), 'independent RCT' / 'independent, placebo-controlled trial' (Procter & Gamble ran it), 'The hero peptide (Palmitoyl Pentapeptide-4)' (not the hero of a Matrixyl 3000 product, and ABSENT from the cream), and 'Well tolerated' (no product-level tolerance data). INGREDIENT-LEVEL ONLY: the manufacturer's in-vivo figures (-39% deep-wrinkle area, +15% ultrasound density) attach to a product only once the formula sheet confirms >=3% Matrixyl 3000 (register claims 1 and 3, §6 gap 1) — parked, so they stay on the hub page. Pentapeptide-4 claims appear only where the serum is in the product (never the cream alone). Argireline and copper kits for the bundles come unchanged from clinical-research-2026-09-22.json (kits_from). Applied by scripts/set-clinical-research.py.

en.headline: Matrixyl® 3000's two peptides raised collagen I by 256% in lab tests on skin cells.
en.intro: The Matrixyl 3000 Firming Serum pairs Matrixyl® 3000 with palmitoyl pentapeptide-4, the original Matrixyl®:
bullets: Collagen I +256% in lab tests, nearly 4× the stronger peptide alone
Palmitoyl pentapeptide-4 reduced the look of wrinkles and fine lines more than placebo in a 12-week double-blind trial of 93 women
Significant from week 8 in that trial, and still at week 12
Both Matrixyl® 3000 peptides assessed safe in cosmetics by an independent expert panel
en.footnote: Lab: Sederma patent US 6,974,799 (human skin cells, 3 days). Trial: Robinson et al. 2005, run by Procter & Gamble scientists. Safety: Cosmetic Ingredient Review 2018. Results describe the ingredients, not this product.

Palmitoyl Pentapeptide-4 verringerte Falten und feine Linien sichtbar stärker als Placebo, in einer 12-wöchigen Doppelblindstudie mit 93 Frauen
In dieser Studie signifikant ab Woche 8 und weiterhin in Woche 12
Beide Peptide von Matrixyl® 3000 von einem unabhängigen Expertengremium als sicher in Kosmetika bewertet
de.footnote: Labor: Sederma-Patent US 6,974,799 (menschliche Hautzellen, 3 Tage). Studie: Robinson et al. 2005, durchgeführt von Wissenschaftlern bei Procter & Gamble. Sicherheit: Cosmetic Ingredient Review 2018. Die Ergebnisse beschreiben die Wirkstoffe, nicht dieses Produkt.
